resources.name: Quick Change
resources.description: Daily move-action persona changes: one at level 2 and one more at levels 6, 10, 14, and 18.

resources.name: Active Persona
resources.description: Record the currently assumed base or alternate persona.

resources.name: Base Persona Active
resources.description: Enable while the Troubadour is in the base persona; this applies Performer’s Synergy.

resources.name: Flexible Truth DC
resources.description: Caster-level/MSB check DC to see through the Troubadour’s constructed truth.

choice_providers.label: Alternate Personas
choice_providers.description: Create two alternate personas at 1st level. Their identity and trope remain independently editable.

choice_providers.label: Actor Training
choice_providers.description: Choose one qualifying Actor Training at every even Troubadour level.

choice_providers.label: Persona Quirks
choice_providers.description: Each alternate persona gains a qualifying quirk at every odd level from 3rd through 19th; record which persona receives it.

notes: Low casting, Proficient combat talents, four class-granted magic talents, personas, quirks, actor training, and quick changes use shared declarations.
